name: 92672 · San Clemente, CA
findings: ZIP 92672 (San Clemente) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92672 (San Clemente) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92672 (San Clemente) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
